Router::with_codec sets the codec the registrations after it decode with. Macros Manual examples/routing.rs #[subscriber("orders")] async fn accept(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order.id, "accepted"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } /// The registrations after `with_codec` decode CBOR. fn orders() -> impl RouterDef<MemoryBroker> { Router::new().with_codec(CborCodec).include(accept) } fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("shop", "0.1.0")) .with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| b.include_router(orders())) } examples/manual/routing.rs struct Accept; impl Handle<Order> for Accept { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, "accepted"); ready(Ok(())) } } /// The registrations after `with_codec` decode CBOR. fn orders() -> impl RouterDef<MemoryBroker> { Router::new() .with_codec(CborCodec) .include(subscriber("orders", Accept).build()) } fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("shop", "0.1.0")) .with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| b.include_router(orders())) }

A subscriber reads a subscription named by a string or by the broker's descriptor, fixed in the attribute or left to the mount site. The attribute fixes the kind of subscription and may leave its value to the mount site: Attribute Kind Value #[subscriber("orders")] by name fixed here #[subscriber] by name .name(..) at the mount site #[subscriber(MemorySource::new("orders"))] the broker's descriptor fixed here #[subscriber(MemorySource)] the broker's descriptor .name(..) at the mount site A name is a Name source and works on any broker that implements Subscribe, which opens its default subscription kind for that name. A descriptor is a type of the broker crate that implements SubscriptionSource and carries the broker's own settings, such as a consumer group or a durable name; the in-memory broker's is MemorySource. The macro reads the descriptor's type off the constructor call, so the expression ends in Type::new(..) and every step after it returns Self. A descriptor kind that the mount site names implements FromName. A source left open must be named: a mount without .name(..) does not compile. .name(..) is one of the mount-site settings and takes any string, so the name may come from configuration read before the app is built. A descriptor kind that needs more than a name, such as a Pulsar topic with its subscription, is written out in full in the attribute. In the manual form the first argument of subscriber is the source: a string, a descriptor, or Unnamed::<Kind>::new() for a source the mount site names, an Unnamed value.

The bare attribute leaves the name to the mount site. Macros Manual examples/subscriber_source.rs /// The attribute leaves the name open: the mount site gives it. #[subscriber] async fn audit(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order.id, "audited"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } fn app(shard: u32) -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("audit", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { b.include(audit.name(format!("audit-{shard}"))) }) } examples/manual/subscriber_source.rs struct Audit; impl Handle<Order> for Audit { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, "audited"); ready(Ok(())) } } fn app(shard: u32) -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("audit", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { // `Unnamed<Name>` is no source yet: the mount does not compile until `.name(..)`. b.include( subscriber(Unnamed::<Name>::new(), Audit) .name(format!("audit-{shard}")) .build(), ) }) }

A descriptor is fixed in the attribute, or only its kind is, and the name comes at the mount site. Macros Manual examples/subscriber_source.rs /// The broker's descriptor, fixed in the attribute. #[subscriber(MemorySource::new("orders"))] async fn accept(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order.id, "accepted"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } /// The descriptor's kind in the attribute, its name at the mount site. #[subscriber(MemorySource)] async fn archive(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order.id, "archived"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { b.include(accept).include(archive.name("archive")) }) } examples/manual/subscriber_source.rs struct Accept; impl Handle<Order> for Accept { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, "accepted"); ready(Ok(())) } } struct Archive; impl Handle<Order> for Archive { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, "archived"); ready(Ok(())) } } fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { // The broker's descriptor, built here. b.include(subscriber(MemorySource::new("orders"), Accept).build()) // The descriptor's kind, named at the mount site. .include( subscriber(Unnamed::<MemorySource>::new(), Archive) .name("archive") .build(), ) }) }

A serde struct is the header contract a handler reads and a publish writes, checked in both directions. A contract is a flat struct: each field names a header, and its value travels as a string. Fields are numbers, booleans, strings, bytes, unit-only enums, or Options of those. An Option field reads as None when its header is absent; any other missing field fails the contract. Header names are matched without regard to case; #[serde(rename = "..")] gives a wire name that is not a Rust identifier. Headers<T> parses the contract before the body runs. A contract that does not parse is a decode failure, settled by the subscriber's on_failure(decode = ..) policy. In a manual body Headers::<T>::from_context(ctx) parses it, and a failure there drops the delivery. The raw HeaderMap of a delivery stays on its context. What the handler publishes carries a contract of its own, declared on the outgoing type.

Macros Manual examples/typed_headers.rs /// What travels in the headers of a chunk: each field is one header, its value a string. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)] struct ChunkMeta { task_id: u64, chunk_no: u32, chunks_total: u32, } /// What travels in the headers of a finished chunk. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)] struct DoneMeta { task_id: u64, chunk_no: u32, } examples/manual/typed_headers.rs /// What travels in the headers of a chunk: each field is one header, its value a string. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)] struct ChunkMeta { task_id: u64, chunk_no: u32, chunks_total: u32, } /// What travels in the headers of a finished chunk. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)] struct DoneMeta { task_id: u64, chunk_no: u32, } Macros Manual examples/typed_headers.rs /// The contract is parsed before the body runs; what the body publishes carries its own. #[subscriber("chunks")] async fn convert( chunk: &Chunk, Headers(meta): Headers<ChunkMeta>, Out(events): Out<impl Publisher, Events>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(meta.task_id, meta.chunk_no, chunk.size, "converting"); let done = ChunkDone { output_key: format!("chunks/{}/{}.part", meta.task_id, meta.chunk_no), }; let done_meta = DoneMeta { task_id: meta.task_id, chunk_no: meta.chunk_no, }; match events .message(&done) .with_headers(&done_meta) .publish() .await { Ok(()) => HandlerOutcome::ack(), Err(_) => HandlerOutcome::retry(), } } examples/manual/typed_headers.rs /// The contract is parsed before the work starts; what the body publishes carries its own. struct Convert; impl<Entry> Handle<Chunk, (), Outs<(Entry,)>> for Convert where Entry: OutEntry<Events, Wire: Publisher>, { async fn handle( &self, chunk: &Chunk, outs: &Outs<(Entry,)>, ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let Headers(meta) = Headers::<ChunkMeta>::from_context(ctx).await?; tracing::info!(meta.task_id, meta.chunk_no, chunk.size, "converting"); let done = ChunkDone { output_key: format!("chunks/{}/{}.part", meta.task_id, meta.chunk_no), }; let done_meta = DoneMeta { task_id: meta.task_id, chunk_no: meta.chunk_no, }; let sent = outs .get(Events) .message(&done) .with_headers(&done_meta) .publish() .await; sent.map_err(|_| HandlerOutcome::retry()) } }

HeaderMap::insert_typed writes a header contract into a header map, the way a publish transform stamps every message of a slot. A field becomes one header named after it, its value written as a string. A None field writes nothing, and a header of the same name is overwritten. A field that holds a nested struct, a sequence or a map is an error. The example's transform is a publish transform on an Out slot, so every message the slot sends carries the contract.

Macros Manual examples/typed_headers.rs /// Where the service runs, as a contract stamped on everything the slot sends. #[derive(Clone, Serialize)] struct Origin { region: &'static str, canary: bool, } struct Stamp(Origin); impl<Options> PublishTransform<ForSlot, Options> for Stamp { type Destination = Reads; fn apply( &self, out: &mut Outgoing<'_>, _options: &mut Option<Options>, _cx: &SlotContext<'_>, ) { if let Err(error) = out.headers_mut().insert_typed(&self.0) { tracing::warn!(%error, "origin headers left out"); } } } fn app() -> impl App { let origin = Origin { region: "eu-west", canary: false, }; RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("transcoder", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { b.include(convert) .out(Events, Publish) .transform(Stamp(origin)) }) } examples/manual/typed_headers.rs /// Where the service runs, as a contract stamped on everything the slot sends. #[derive(Clone, Serialize)] struct Origin { region: &'static str, canary: bool, } struct Stamp(Origin); impl<Options> PublishTransform<ForSlot, Options> for Stamp { type Destination = Reads; fn apply( &self, out: &mut Outgoing<'_>, _options: &mut Option<Options>, _cx: &SlotContext<'_>, ) { if let Err(error) = out.headers_mut().insert_typed(&self.0) { tracing::warn!(%error, "origin headers left out"); } } } fn app() -> impl App { let origin = Origin { region: "eu-west", canary: false, }; RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("transcoder", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { b.include(subscriber("chunks", Convert).build()) .out(Events, Publish) .transform(Stamp(origin)) }) }

Message<H, T> hands a handler the decoded payload and its parsed header contract as one input. chunk.headers is the contract and chunk.body the payload. The contract parses the way Headers<T> parses it, and a contract that does not parse is a decode failure. A batch handler takes &[Message<H, T>], so each element keeps its own headers. A reply typed Message<H, T> carries its headers the same way.

Macros Manual examples/typed_headers.rs /// The payload and its contract arrive decoded together. #[subscriber("chunks")] async fn store(chunk: &Message<ChunkMeta, Chunk>) -> HandlerOutcome { let meta = &chunk.headers; if meta.chunk_no >= meta.chunks_total { // A chunk past the end of its task. return HandlerOutcome::drop(); } tracing::info!(meta.task_id, meta.chunk_no, chunk.body.size, "stored"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } examples/manual/typed_headers.rs /// The payload and its contract arrive decoded together. struct Store; impl Handle<Message<ChunkMeta, Chunk>> for Store { fn handle( &self, chunk: &Message<ChunkMeta, Chunk>, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { let meta = &chunk.headers; if meta.chunk_no >= meta.chunks_total { // A chunk past the end of its task. return ready(Err(HandlerOutcome::drop())); } tracing::info!(meta.task_id, meta.chunk_no, chunk.body.size, "stored"); ready(Ok(())) } }

A message type names its header contract, so publishing it does not compile without the headers. #[outgoing(headers = Meta)] makes the contract part of the message type, the type's MessageHeaders contract. Its publish does not compile without .with_headers(&meta). The manual form implements MessageHeaders by hand and names the contract as its Contract; a type with none names NoHeaders. An Out slot lists the types it may publish in #[publishes(..)], and each keeps its own contract, as on the Slots page. The handler on the Headers page publishes a ChunkDone through such a slot.

Macros Manual examples/typed_headers.rs /// A chunk: publishing one does not compile without its `ChunkMeta`. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "chunks", headers = ChunkMeta)] struct Chunk { size: u64, } /// A finished chunk: publishing one does not compile without its `DoneMeta`. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "chunks.done", headers = DoneMeta)] struct ChunkDone { output_key: String, } examples/manual/typed_headers.rs /// A chunk: publishing one does not compile without its `ChunkMeta`. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)] struct Chunk { size: u64, } impl OutgoingDestination for Chunk { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "chunks"; } impl MessageHeaders for Chunk { type Contract = WithHeaders<ChunkMeta>; } /// A finished chunk: publishing one does not compile without its `DoneMeta`. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)] struct ChunkDone { output_key: String, } impl OutgoingDestination for ChunkDone { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "chunks.done"; } impl MessageHeaders for ChunkDone { type Contract = WithHeaders<DoneMeta>; } Macros Manual examples/typed_headers.rs /// The slot the converter publishes through, and what it may publish. #[derive(OutSlot)] #[publishes(ChunkDone)] struct Events; examples/manual/typed_headers.rs /// The slot the converter publishes through, and what it may publish. struct Events; impl OutSlot for Events { const NAME: &'static str = "Events"; type Destination = Reads; fn outgoing() -> Vec<OutgoingMessageMetadata> { <ChunkDone as OutMessages<Self>>::outgoing() } } impl PublishedThrough<Events> for ChunkDone {} impl<M: OutSlot> OutMessages<M> for ChunkDone { fn outgoing() -> Vec<OutgoingMessageMetadata> { vec![OutgoingMessageMetadata::new( Self::DESTINATION, type_name::<Self>(), )] } }

指南带你从一个空 crate 走到一个运行中的 RustStream 服务。 安装：crate、它的 cargo feature 以及 Broker crate。 快速上手：用 cargo generate 生成并运行的服务。 教程：一个订单服务，包含消息类型、处理器、回复和路由器，运行在内存 Broker 上。 智能体技能：让编码智能体按推荐方式编写服务、测试和 Broker crate 的技能。 逐步构建一个服务：同一个商店服务逐章扩展，从第一个订阅者一直到联网的 Broker。 Broker：各个 Broker crate，以及如何把服务迁移到另一个 Broker。

十一章内容逐步扩展同一个 RustStream 服务（一家小商店），从第一个订阅者一直到联网的 Broker。 商店接收订单、收款、发货，并通知顾客。 每一步是一个订阅者，各步之间通过主题通信。 商店运行在内存 Broker 上，所以每一章都不需要安装任何东西。 每一章引入它需要的组件，并链接到组件中对应的页面。 每个代码块有两个标签页：“宏”使用属性和 derive，“手写”是手工写出的同一段代码。 完成后的商店位于仓库的 examples/guide，手写版本位于 examples/manual/guide。 CI 在每次改动时构建这两者，并运行它们的测试。 商店的每个部分是一个模块：orders.rs、payments.rs、shipping.rs 和 notifications.rs。 state.rs 存放订阅者共享的内容，observability.rs 是商店自己的一个中间件，service.rs 组装应用。 main.rs 是命令行入口，http.rs 让同一个商店运行在 HTTP 服务器旁边。

asyncapi gen 打印商店的 AsyncAPI 文档：每个主题、谁读谁写、schema、重试上限，以及应用对自己的描述。 文档由应用本身构建，所以它不可能描述代码没有使用的主题。 每个订阅是一个 receive 操作，每个回复和槽位是一个 send 操作。 载荷的 schema 来自它的 JsonSchema derive，文档注释成为描述。 max_attempts 和 dead_letter 出现在操作上，读者能看到失败的消息最终去了哪里。 AsyncAPI 讲解服务器、安全方案，以及通过 HTTP 提供文档。 文档需要 crate 的 asyncapi feature。

main.rs 在内存 Broker 上构建商店。 #[ruststream::app] 给二进制程序提供命令：run 启动商店，asyncapi gen 打印文档。 宏 手写 main.rs /// `run` starts the shop; `asyncapi gen` prints its AsyncAPI document. #[ruststream::app(flavor = "current_thread")] fn app() -> impl App<State = Shop> { service::shop(MemoryBroker::new()) } main.rs fn app() -> impl App<State = Shop> { service::shop(MemoryBroker::new()) } /// What `#[ruststream::app]` writes: `run` starts the shop; `asyncapi gen` prints its AsyncAPI /// document. fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main_on(AppRuntime::CurrentThread, app) }

AppInfo 是文档的 info 块：标题、版本、描述、联系方式、许可证和标签。 宏 手写 service.rs /// What the AsyncAPI document says about the shop. fn info() -> AppInfo { AppInfo::new("shop", "0.1.0") .description("Takes orders, charges them, ships them and tells the customer.") .contact(Contact::new().name("Shop team").email("shop@example.com")) .license(License::new("Apache-2.0")) .tag(Tag::new("orders")) } service.rs /// What the AsyncAPI document says about the shop. fn info() -> AppInfo { AppInfo::new("shop", "0.1.0") .description("Takes orders, charges them, ships them and tells the customer.") .contact(Contact::new().name("Shop team").email("shop@example.com")) .license(License::new("Apache-2.0")) .tag(Tag::new("orders")) }

cargo run --example guide --features testing,macros,memory,json,cbor,asyncapi -- asyncapi gen --yaml charge 的操作读取主题，在 payments.settled 上回复，并声明上限： receive_payments_requested: action: receive channel: $ref: '#/channels/payments.requested' messages: - $ref: '#/channels/payments.requested/messages/PaymentRequest' description: Charges an order through the payment provider. reply: channel: $ref: '#/channels/payments.settled' messages: - $ref: '#/channels/payments.settled/messages/Paid' x-ruststream-retry: maxAttempts: 5 deadLetter: payments.dead 商店的两种形式生成相同的文档。 两者各有一个测试，把文档与 examples/guide/asyncapi.json 比较，所以主题的改动会在评审中显现出来。

打包是计算任务，所以它有两个专属线程；预约快递要等待网络，所以四个预约同时进行。 默认情况下，一个订阅一次处理一次投递，顺序与 Broker 交付的顺序相同。 工作者让订阅在应用的运行时上同时处理多次投递，适合等待 I/O 的处理器。 线程给订阅分配专属线程，适合做计算的处理器。否则这样的处理器会阻塞为其他所有订阅服务的运行时。 两者都是订阅的设置，处理器的主体不需要改动。 使用工作者或线程的订阅不再保持投递的顺序。workers(n, by_key) 保持每个键内的顺序。

pack 把已付款的订单拆分成包裹，并以打包方案作为回复。 超出商店上限的已付款订单，在规划任何包裹之前就被丢弃。 threads(2) 随订阅启动两个线程，投递轮流分给它们。 解码、主体、回复和结算都在收到该投递的线程上运行。 宏 手写 shipping.rs /// Packs a paid order into parcels. // Packing is computation: two threads of its own keep it off the app's runtime, which serves I/O. #[subscriber("payments.settled", threads(2), reply)] async fn pack(paid: &Paid) -> Result<Packed, HandlerOutcome> { if !within_bounds(&paid.lines) { tracing::warn!( order = paid.order, "a paid order past the shop's bounds, dropped" ); return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); } Ok(Packed { order: paid.order, customer: paid.customer.clone(), parcels: plan(&paid.lines), }) } shipping.rs /// Packs a paid order into parcels. struct Pack; impl Handle<Paid, Packed, (), (), Shop> for Pack { fn handle( &self, paid: &Paid, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Shop>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Packed, HandlerOutcome>> { if !within_bounds(&paid.lines) { tracing::warn!( order = paid.order, "a paid order past the shop's bounds, dropped" ); return ready(Err(HandlerOutcome::drop())); } ready(Ok(Packed { order: paid.order, customer: paid.customer.clone(), parcels: plan(&paid.lines), })) } }

dispatch 为已打包的订单预约快递，并把快递单号告诉顾客。 workers(4) 让最多四个预约同时进行，下一次投递等待空闲的工作者。 宏 手写 shipping.rs /// Books a courier for a packed order and tells the customer. // Booking waits on the courier's API, so four bookings run at once. #[subscriber("shipping.packed", workers(4))] async fn dispatch(packed: &Packed, Out(notices): Out<impl Publisher, Notices>) -> HandlerOutcome { let tracking = book_courier(packed).await; let notice = Notice { customer: packed.customer.clone(), text: format!("Order {} is on its way: {tracking}.", packed.order), }; match notices.message(&notice).publish().await { Ok(()) => HandlerOutcome::ack(), Err(_) => HandlerOutcome::retry(), } } shipping.rs /// Books a courier for a packed order and tells the customer. struct Dispatch; impl<Entry> Handle<Packed, (), Outs<(Entry,)>, (), Shop> for Dispatch where Entry: OutEntry<Notices, Wire: Publisher>, { async fn handle( &self, packed: &Packed, outs: &Outs<(Entry,)>, _ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Shop>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let tracking = book_courier(packed).await; let notice = Notice { customer: packed.customer.clone(), text: format!("Order {} is on its way: {tracking}.", packed.order), }; let sent = outs.get(Notices).message(&notice).publish().await; sent.map_err(|_| HandlerOutcome::retry()) } }

发货路由器读取商店内部的主题，所以它解码 CBOR。 回复使用默认编解码器，除非它的发布位置另行指定，所以 pack 的回复指定了 CBOR。 槽位使用路由器的编解码器，除非它另行指定，所以通知指定了 JSON。 在手写形式中，这两项设置是挂载链上的步骤：threads 和 workers。 计算步骤运行在自己的线程上，应用运行时只需等待 I/O，因此商店把它放在调用 main 的线程上运行：#[ruststream::app(flavor = "current_thread")]，手写形式为 run_main_on(AppRuntime::CurrentThread, app)。后面一章中带 HTTP 的入口用 #[tokio::main(flavor = "current_thread")] 做同样的事。 宏 手写 shipping.rs /// The shipping side's subscribers. Both read the shop's own topics, so both decode CBOR. pub(crate) fn routes() -> impl RouterDef<MemoryBroker, Shop> { Router::new() .with_codec(INTERNAL) .include(pack) // A reply encodes with the default codec unless its position names one. .out_reply(Publish) .codec(INTERNAL) .build() .include(dispatch) // A slot encodes with the router's codec unless it names one; notices stay JSON. .out(Notices, Publish) .codec(JsonCodec) .build() } shipping.rs /// The shipping side's subscribers. Both read the shop's own topics, so both decode CBOR. pub(crate) fn routes() -> impl RouterDef<MemoryBroker, Shop> { Router::new() .with_codec(INTERNAL) .include( subscriber(Paid::DESTINATION, Pack) .describe("Packs a paid order into parcels.") // Packing is computation: two threads of its own keep it off the app's runtime. .threads(nonzero!(2)) .reply() .build(), ) // A reply encodes with the default codec unless its position names one. .out_reply(Publish) .codec(INTERNAL) .build() .include( subscriber(Packed::DESTINATION, Dispatch) .describe("Books a courier for a packed order and tells the customer.") // Booking waits on the courier's API, so four bookings run at once. .workers(nonzero!(4)) .build(), ) // A slot encodes with the router's codec unless it names one; notices stay JSON. .out(Notices, Publish) .codec(JsonCodec) .build() } 每次投递的计算量达到约十微秒时，线程才划算。处理器更轻时，线程的开销超过收益。 轮询诊断能找出阻塞运行时的处理器。

店面通过 HTTP 接收订单，把订单连同事件一起存储；中继把事件交给 Broker，商店运行在服务器旁边。 服务同时提供 HTTP 时，进程归 HTTP 服务器所有，商店运行在它旁边。 start 在后台启动商店，商店运行起来后才返回。因此，如果 Broker 拒绝连接，进程会在服务器接收请求之前停止。 HTTP 请求不应自己向 Broker 发布：Broker 故障会让请求失败，而存储了订单却没有事件，订单就永远到不了商店。 事务性 outbox 同时解决这两个问题。 请求在一个事务中写入订单和它的事件，中继稍后发布已存储的事件。 Broker 故障只会推迟事件，不会丢失任何事件。如果在发布和删除之间发生崩溃，事件会再发布一次，所以每个订单商店至少会看到一次。
documents.s: 在 HTTP 服务器旁运行，outbox

documents.t: 使用真实数据库时，订单和 outbox 是在一个事务中写入的两张表。 这里由一个保护这两者的互斥锁承担这个角色。 只有真实数据库能让事件在崩溃后保留下来：这里的行存放在内存中，一旦崩溃，尚未发布的行就会丢失。 宏 手写 http.rs /// The orders the storefront took, and the events the shop still owes the broker. With a real /// database both writes run in one transaction; the mutex over the pair plays that role here. #[derive(Default)] struct Store { orders: Vec<Order>, outbox: VecDeque<(RequestMeta, Order)>, } http.rs /// The orders the storefront took, and the events the shop still owes the broker. With a real /// database both writes run in one transaction; the mutex over the pair plays that role here. #[derive(Default)] struct Store { orders: Vec<Order>, outbox: VecDeque<(RequestMeta, Order)>, } HTTP 部分和 outbox 都是普通函数，所以两个标签页中的代码相同。

POST /orders 以 JSON 接收订单，从 x-request-id 消息头读取请求 id。 它只写入存储，所以不等待 Broker 就以 202 Accepted 应答。 超出商店上限的订单以 400 Bad Request 应答，不会被存储。 宏 手写 http.rs /// Takes an order over HTTP. The request only writes to the store, so no broker I/O can fail or /// stall the response. async fn place_order( State(store): State<Arc<Mutex<Store>>>, headers: HeaderMap, Json(order): Json<Order>, ) -> (StatusCode, &'static str) { let request_id = headers .get("x-request-id") .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok()) .unwrap_or("unknown") .to_owned(); if total_cents(&order.lines).is_none() { return ( StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "the order is past the shop's bounds
", ); } { let mut store = store.lock().await; store.orders.push(order.clone()); store.outbox.push_back((RequestMeta { request_id }, order)); } (StatusCode::ACCEPTED, "accepted
") } http.rs /// Takes an order over HTTP. The request only writes to the store, so no broker I/O can fail or /// stall the response. async fn place_order( State(store): State<Arc<Mutex<Store>>>, headers: HeaderMap, Json(order): Json<Order>, ) -> (StatusCode, &'static str) { let request_id = headers .get("x-request-id") .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok()) .unwrap_or("unknown") .to_owned(); if total_cents(&order.lines).is_none() { return ( StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "the order is past the shop's bounds
", ); } { let mut store = store.lock().await; store.orders.push(order.clone()); store.outbox.push_back((RequestMeta { request_id }, order)); } (StatusCode::ACCEPTED, "accepted
") }

中继先发布最早的事件，并带上它的消息头契约，发布成功之后才删除它。 发布被拒绝时，这一行留到下一轮处理。 中继一直运行到进程让它停止，然后再执行最后一轮。 发布者可以是任意 Publisher，所以更换 Broker 时中继不变。 宏 手写 http.rs /// Hands the outbox to the broker, oldest event first. A row leaves the outbox only after its /// publish succeeded, so a broker outage delays events and loses none. async fn relay_pending(store: &Mutex<Store>, egress: &impl Publisher) { loop { let Some((meta, order)) = store.lock().await.outbox.front().cloned() else { return; }; let sent = egress .message(&order) .with_headers(&meta) .with_codec(JsonCodec) .publish() .await; if sent.is_err() { // The row stays for the next round. return; } store.lock().await.outbox.pop_front(); } } /// Runs the relay every 200 milliseconds until `stop` completes, then runs it once more. async fn relay_outbox( store: Arc<Mutex<Store>>, egress: impl Publisher, stop: impl Future<Output = ()>, ) { let mut rounds = time::interval(Duration::from_millis(200)); tokio::pin!(stop); loop { tokio::select! { biased; () = &mut stop => break, _ = rounds.tick() => relay_pending(&store, &egress).await, } } // The last round runs once no request writes a row any more, so it empties the outbox. relay_pending(&store, &egress).await; } http.rs /// Hands the outbox to the broker, oldest event first. A row leaves the outbox only after its /// publish succeeded, so a broker outage delays events and loses none. async fn relay_pending(store: &Mutex<Store>, egress: &impl Publisher) { loop { let Some((meta, order)) = store.lock().await.outbox.front().cloned() else { return; }; let sent = egress .message(&order) .with_headers(&meta) .with_codec(JsonCodec) .publish() .await; if sent.is_err() { // The row stays for the next round. return; } store.lock().await.outbox.pop_front(); } } /// Runs the relay every 200 milliseconds until `stop` completes, then runs it once more. async fn relay_outbox( store: Arc<Mutex<Store>>, egress: impl Publisher, stop: impl Future<Output = ()>, ) { let mut rounds = time::interval(Duration::from_millis(200)); tokio::pin!(stop); loop { tokio::select! { biased; () = &mut stop => break, _ = rounds.tick() => relay_pending(&store, &egress).await, } } // The last round runs once no request writes a row any more, so it empties the outbox. relay_pending(&store, &egress).await; }

bindable 让进程在商店启动之前拿到一个发布者令牌，Broker 连接之后，publisher 把令牌变成可用的发布者。 服务器在 Ctrl+C 时停止，或者在 stopping 报告商店自行停止时停止。 HTTP 处理完所有请求之后，进程停止中继，中继的最后一轮在商店仍在运行时交出剩余的行。 然后商店用 shutdown 处理完剩余的工作。 MemoryBroker 也把队列存放在进程内存中：最后一轮交出、但商店在排空前还没取走的订单会随进程一起丢失，而会保存消息的 Broker 会把它留到下一次启动。 手写的 main 自己用 ruststream::logging::init() 安装日志记录器。 宏 手写 http.rs #[tokio::main(flavor = "current_thread")] async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { logging::init()?; let broker = MemoryBroker::new().bindable(); // A token now, a live publisher once the shop has connected the broker. let egress = broker.bind(Publish); // The shop starts first: a broker that refuses to connect stops the process before HTTP // takes a request. let running = shop(broker).start().await?; let egress = running.publisher(egress).await?; let store = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Store::default())); let stop_relay = CancellationToken::new(); let relay = tokio::spawn(relay_outbox( Arc::clone(&store), egress, stop_relay.clone().cancelled_owned(), )); let router = axum::Router::new() .route("/orders", post(place_order)) .with_state(store); let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:8080").await?; tracing::info!("storefront on http://127.0.0.1:8080/orders"); // HTTP stops on Ctrl+C, or when the shop stops on its own; the shop then drains. let stopping = running.stopping(); axum::serve(listener, router) .with_graceful_shutdown(async move { tokio::select! { _ = signal::ctrl_c() => {} () = stopping => {} } }) .await?; // HTTP has drained, so no request writes a row any more: the relay's last round hands the // pending rows over while the shop still runs, and only then does the shop drain. stop_relay.cancel(); relay.await?; running.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } http.rs #[tokio::main(flavor = "current_thread")] async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { logging::init()?; let broker = MemoryBroker::new().bindable(); // A token now, a live publisher once the shop has connected the broker. let egress = broker.bind(Publish); // The shop starts first: a broker that refuses to connect stops the process before HTTP // takes a request. let running = shop(broker).start().await?; let egress = running.publisher(egress).await?; let store = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Store::default())); let stop_relay = CancellationToken::new(); let relay = tokio::spawn(relay_outbox( Arc::clone(&store), egress, stop_relay.clone().cancelled_owned(), )); let router = axum::Router::new() .route("/orders", post(place_order)) .with_state(store); let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:8080").await?; tracing::info!("storefront on http://127.0.0.1:8080/orders"); // HTTP stops on Ctrl+C, or when the shop stops on its own; the shop then drains. let stopping = running.stopping(); axum::serve(listener, router) .with_graceful_shutdown(async move { tokio::select! { _ = signal::ctrl_c() => {} () = stopping => {} } }) .await?; // HTTP has drained, so no request writes a row any more: the relay's last round hands the // pending rows over while the shop still runs, and only then does the shop drain. stop_relay.cancel(); relay.await?; running.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } 运行它，然后下一个订单： cargo run --example guide_http --features testing,macros,memory,json,cbor,asyncapi,logging curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/orders -H 'content-type: application/json' \ -H 'x-request-id: req-1' \ -d '{"id":1,"customer":"ada@example.com","lines":[{"sku":"mug","quantity":12,"price_cents":1200}]}' 第 5 章的日志会跟随这个订单走完整个商店。 健康检查端点在同一个服务器上向编排系统报告商店的状态。

订单扩展为带订单行的载荷，加上每次发布都必须携带的消息头契约，以及按主题选定的编解码器。 载荷可以是任意 serde 类型。编解码器把它转换成字节，也把字节转换回来。 消息头与载荷一起传递。消息头契约是一个 serde 结构体，每个字段对应一个消息头。 如果消息类型指定了契约，不带契约就无法发布：这样的发布无法编译。 订阅者通过 Headers<T> 参数读取契约，解析发生在主体运行之前。 消息头解析失败的投递不会到达主体，而是被丢弃，与无法解码的载荷相同。 编解码器属于挂载点，而不属于类型。因此同一个类型可以在一个主题上以 JSON 传递，在另一个主题上以 CBOR 传递。
documents.s: 消息：载荷、消息头、编解码器

documents.t: 从这里开始，商店的代码放在各个模块里。 orders.rs 存放订单：订单行、总额，以及随订单一起传递的契约。 上限规定一个订单最多能买多少，总额用带溢出检查的算术累加，所以超出上限的订单没有总额。 宏 手写 orders.rs /// How many lines an order may hold. pub(crate) const MAX_LINES: usize = 100; /// How many items one line may order. pub(crate) const MAX_QUANTITY: u32 = 1_000; /// The highest price of one item, in cents. pub(crate) const MAX_PRICE_CENTS: u64 = 1_000_000; /// One line of an order: what the customer buys, how many, and at what price. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema)] pub(crate) struct Line { pub(crate) sku: String, pub(crate) quantity: u32, pub(crate) price_cents: u64, } /// An order placed in the storefront. It travels with the headers of the request that placed it. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "orders.placed", headers = RequestMeta)] pub(crate) struct Order { pub(crate) id: u64, pub(crate) customer: String, pub(crate) lines: Vec<Line>, } /// Whether `lines` stay within the shop's bounds. pub(crate) fn within_bounds(lines: &[Line]) -> bool { lines.len() <= MAX_LINES && lines .iter() .all(|line| line.quantity <= MAX_QUANTITY && line.price_cents <= MAX_PRICE_CENTS) } /// What `lines` cost together, or `None` past the shop's bounds. pub(crate) fn total_cents(lines: &[Line]) -> Option<u64> { if !within_bounds(lines) { return None; } lines.iter().try_fold(0_u64, |total, line| { total.checked_add(u64::from(line.quantity).checked_mul(line.price_cents)?) }) } orders.rs /// How many lines an order may hold. pub(crate) const MAX_LINES: usize = 100; /// How many items one line may order. pub(crate) const MAX_QUANTITY: u32 = 1_000; /// The highest price of one item, in cents. pub(crate) const MAX_PRICE_CENTS: u64 = 1_000_000; /// One line of an order: what the customer buys, how many, and at what price. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema)] pub(crate) struct Line { pub(crate) sku: String, pub(crate) quantity: u32, pub(crate) price_cents: u64, } /// An order placed in the storefront. It travels with the headers of the request that placed it. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema)] pub(crate) struct Order { pub(crate) id: u64, pub(crate) customer: String, pub(crate) lines: Vec<Line>, } // What `#[derive(Outgoing)]` with `#[outgoing(name = "orders.placed", headers = RequestMeta)]` // writes: the destination, the headers a publish must carry, and the name in the document. impl OutgoingDestination for Order { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "orders.placed"; } impl MessageHeaders for Order { type Contract = WithHeaders<RequestMeta>; } impl MessageInfo for Order { const NAME: &'static str = "Order"; const DESCRIPTION: Option<&'static str> = Some( "An order placed in the storefront. It travels with the headers of the request that \ placed it.", ); } /// Whether `lines` stay within the shop's bounds. pub(crate) fn within_bounds(lines: &[Line]) -> bool { lines.len() <= MAX_LINES && lines .iter() .all(|line| line.quantity <= MAX_QUANTITY && line.price_cents <= MAX_PRICE_CENTS) } /// What `lines` cost together, or `None` past the shop's bounds. pub(crate) fn total_cents(lines: &[Line]) -> Option<u64> { if !within_bounds(lines) { return None; } lines.iter().try_fold(0_u64, |total, line| { total.checked_add(u64::from(line.quantity).checked_mul(line.price_cents)?) }) } headers = RequestMeta 让契约成为类型的一部分。 手写形式用 type Contract = WithHeaders<RequestMeta> 表达同样的意思，并通过一个 MessageInfo impl 为消息在 AsyncAPI 文档中命名。

契约的每个字段是一个消息头。 request_id 指明下单的那次店面请求，这样每一步都能记录它。 宏 手写 orders.rs /// The headers of a placed order: each field is one header. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema)] pub(crate) struct RequestMeta { pub(crate) request_id: String, } orders.rs /// The headers of a placed order: each field is one header. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema)] pub(crate) struct RequestMeta { pub(crate) request_id: String, }

audit 是 orders.placed 上的第二个订阅者：它把每个订单连同下单请求写进审计日志。 每个订阅都会收到其主题的每一条消息，因此 audit 和下一章的 accept 都能看到每个订单。 手写形式以 Message<RequestMeta, Order> 这一对作为输入：两部分都在主体运行之前解码，AsyncAPI 文档会展示消息头的 schema。 宏 手写 orders.rs /// Writes every placed order to the audit log, with the request that placed it. #[subscriber("orders.placed")] async fn audit(order: &Order, Headers(meta): Headers<RequestMeta>) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!( request = %meta.request_id, order = order.id, total_cents = total_cents(&order.lines), "order placed", ); HandlerOutcome::ack() } orders.rs /// Writes every placed order to the audit log, with the request that placed it. struct Audit; // The input is the pair of headers and payload: both decode before the body runs, and the // document shows the header schema, as a `Headers<RequestMeta>` parameter does with the macros. impl Handle<Message<RequestMeta, Order>, (), (), (), Shop> for Audit { fn handle( &self, placed: &Message<RequestMeta, Order>, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Shop>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { let (meta, order) = (&placed.headers, &placed.body); tracing::info!( request = %meta.request_id, order = order.id, total_cents = total_cents(&order.lines), "order placed", ); ready(Ok(())) } }

JSON 是默认编解码器。orders.placed 和 notices 由其他团队读取，商店在这两个主题上保留 JSON。 商店各步之间的主题以 CBOR 传递：体积更小，而且没有别人读取。 一个常量指定这个编解码器，这样后面几章的路由器不会在这一点上出现分歧。 宏 手写 payments.rs /// The codec of the topics between the shop's own steps: CBOR is smaller than JSON, and no /// other team reads them. pub(crate) const INTERNAL: CborCodec = CborCodec; payments.rs /// The codec of the topics between the shop's own steps: CBOR is smaller than JSON, and no /// other team reads them. pub(crate) const INTERNAL: CborCodec = CborCodec; 路由器用 with_codec 指定的编解码器解码，每个发布位置用 .codec(..) 指定自己的编解码器。 下一章会同时用到这两者。 CBOR 需要 crate 的 cbor feature。
documents.s: 商店内部主题的编解码器

documents.t: 应用用两层包裹每个订阅者：一层记录每次投递及其结果，另一层是商店自己的，对运行过慢的处理器发出警告。 Layer 把一个处理器包裹在另一个处理器里。 它在主体之前、之后或者代替主体运行代码，并把结果传递下去。 应用上的层包裹应用挂载的每个订阅者，路由器上的层只包裹该路由器的订阅者。 RustStream 通过 tracing 发出自己的事件：服务启动、每个订阅打开、服务停止。 TracingLayer 为每次投递添加事件：先在 DEBUG 级别记录 delivery received，然后记录它的结果。ack 在 INFO 级别，重试或丢弃在 WARN 级别。 logging feature 会打印这些事件，第 1 章已经展示过。任何其他 tracing 订阅者都可以代替它。 可观测性讲解 Prometheus 指标和 OpenTelemetry 导出，它们同样以层的形式挂载。

SlowHandlers 为每个处理器计时，运行时间超过阈值时发出警告。 警告中指明订阅，订阅名取自投递的上下文。 层没有宏形式：两个标签页中是同一个普通类型。 应用的处理器类型是隐藏的，BlanketLayer 让应用能把这个层应用到它们上。 宏 手写 observability.rs /// Warns about every delivery whose handler ran longer than the threshold. #[derive(Clone)] pub(crate) struct SlowHandlers { threshold: Duration, } impl SlowHandlers { pub(crate) const fn over(threshold: Duration) -> Self { Self { threshold } } } /// The handler `SlowHandlers` makes of the one it wraps. pub(crate) struct Timed<H> { inner: H, threshold: Duration, } impl<H> Layer<H> for SlowHandlers { type Handler = Timed<H>; fn layer(&self, inner: H) -> Timed<H> { Timed { inner, threshold: self.threshold, } } } impl<M, C, S, H> Handler<M, C, S> for Timed<H> where M: Send + Sync, C: Send, S: Send + Sync, H: Handler<M, C, S>, { async fn handle(&self, msg: &M, ctx: &mut Context<'_, C, S>) -> HandlerOutcome { let started = Instant::now(); let outcome = self.inner.handle(msg, ctx).await; let took = started.elapsed(); if took > self.threshold { tracing::warn!(subscription = ctx.name(), ?took, "slow handler"); } outcome } } // The app wraps handlers whose types it hides, through this generic method. impl BlanketLayer for SlowHandlers { fn apply<M, C, S, H>(&self, handler: H) -> impl Handler<M, C, S> + 'static where M: Send + Sync + 'static, C: Send + 'static, S: Send + Sync + 'static, H: Handler<M, C, S> + 'static, { self.layer(handler) } } observability.rs /// Warns about every delivery whose handler ran longer than the threshold. #[derive(Clone)] pub(crate) struct SlowHandlers { threshold: Duration, } impl SlowHandlers { pub(crate) const fn over(threshold: Duration) -> Self { Self { threshold } } } /// The handler `SlowHandlers` makes of the one it wraps. pub(crate) struct Timed<H> { inner: H, threshold: Duration, } impl<H> Layer<H> for SlowHandlers { type Handler = Timed<H>; fn layer(&self, inner: H) -> Timed<H> { Timed { inner, threshold: self.threshold, } } } impl<M, C, S, H> Handler<M, C, S> for Timed<H> where M: Send + Sync, C: Send, S: Send + Sync, H: Handler<M, C, S>, { async fn handle(&self, msg: &M, ctx: &mut Context<'_, C, S>) -> HandlerOutcome { let started = Instant::now(); let outcome = self.inner.handle(msg, ctx).await; let took = started.elapsed(); if took > self.threshold { tracing::warn!(subscription = ctx.name(), ?took, "slow handler"); } outcome } } // The app wraps handlers whose types it hides, through this generic method. impl BlanketLayer for SlowHandlers { fn apply<M, C, S, H>(&self, handler: H) -> impl Handler<M, C, S> + 'static where M: Send + Sync + 'static, C: Send + 'static, S: Send + Sync + 'static, H: Handler<M, C, S> + 'static, { self.layer(handler) } }

service.rs 组装商店。 layer 给应用添加一个层，最先添加的层位于最外层。 每个模块的路由器用 include_router 挂载，应用的层包裹其中的订阅者。 on_startup 打开第 7 章的共享状态，info() 是第 9 章的描述。 函数以 Broker 作为参数，因此命令行入口和第 10 章的 HTTP 宿主构建的是同一个商店。 宏 手写 service.rs /// The whole shop on `broker`. The command-line entry point and the HTTP host both build it here. pub(crate) fn shop( broker: impl BrokerRegistration<Broker = MemoryBroker>, ) -> impl App<State = Shop> { RustStream::new(info()) .on_startup(async move |()| Shop::open().await) .layer(TracingLayer::default()) .layer(SlowHandlers::over(Duration::from_millis(250))) .with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include_router(orders::routes()) .include_router(payments::routes()) .include_router(shipping::routes()) .include_router(notifications::routes()) }) } service.rs /// The whole shop on `broker`. The command-line entry point and the HTTP host both build it here. pub(crate) fn shop( broker: impl BrokerRegistration<Broker = MemoryBroker>, ) -> impl App<State = Shop> { RustStream::new(info()) .on_startup(async move |()| Shop::open().await) .layer(TracingLayer::default()) .layer(SlowHandlers::over(Duration::from_millis(250))) .with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include_router(orders::routes()) .include_router(payments::routes()) .include_router(shipping::routes()) .include_router(notifications::routes()) }) }

用请求 id req-1 下单后，每一步留下一行日志： INFO guide_http::orders order placed request=req-1 order=1 total_cents=14400 INFO ruststream::dispatch handler ack INFO ruststream::dispatch handler ack INFO ruststream::dispatch handler ack INFO guide_http::notifications mail sent server=smtp://mail.internal:25 to="ada@example.com" text="We have your order 1." INFO ruststream::dispatch handler ack INFO ruststream::dispatch handler ack INFO ruststream::dispatch handler ack INFO guide_http::notifications mail sent server=smtp://mail.internal:25 to="ada@example.com" text="Order 1 is on its way: TRK-1-2." INFO ruststream::dispatch handler ack RUST_LOG 调节打印哪些内容，例如 RUST_LOG=ruststream=debug,info。

更换构建商店所用的 Broker，商店就迁移到 NATS；订阅者和路由器的设置都保持不变。 Broker 只在一个地方选定：传给 shop 的值。 Broker crate 提供 Broker 类型和一个 prelude，其中的名字与内存 Broker 的 prelude 相同，Publish 也在其中。 因此路由器在每个 Broker 上读起来都一样，变化的只有它指明的类型。 订阅者的主体不从 Broker 导入任何东西，所以完全不需要改动。 每个 Broker 都有自己的 crate，本章使用 ruststream-nats。

Cargo.toml [dependencies] ruststream = { version = "0.8", features = ["macros", "json", "cbor", "asyncapi", "logging"] } ruststream-nats = { version = "0.8", features = ["asyncapi"] } 不再需要 memory feature。 两个 crate 的 testing feature 放进 [dev-dependencies]。

入口在 NatsBroker 上构建商店。与内存 Broker 一样，它只在服务启动时才连接。 宏 手写 main.rs use ruststream_nats::prelude::*; use crate::state::Shop; #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App<State = Shop> { service::shop(NatsBroker::new("nats://localhost:4222")) } main.rs use std::process::ExitCode; use ruststream::runtime::cli::run_main; use ruststream_nats::prelude::*; use crate::state::Shop; fn app() -> impl App<State = Shop> { service::shop(NatsBroker::new("nats://localhost:4222")) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } 其他文件有两处改动。 每个文件导入 ruststream_nats::prelude::*，代替 ruststream::memory::prelude::*。 每个路由器返回 RouterDef<NatsBroker, Shop>，shop 接收类型为 NatsBroker 的 Broker。 编解码器、槽位、尝试上限和死信主题保持不变。 http.rs 以同样的方式在 NatsBroker::new(..).bindable() 上绑定它的发布者令牌。

NatsBroker 有进程内模式，所以 TestApp 不需要服务器就能运行商店，与在内存 Broker 上一样。 测试从 service.rs 的 test_broker 取得 Broker，现在它构建的是 NatsBroker： service.rs #[cfg(test)] pub(crate) fn test_broker() -> NatsBroker { NatsBroker::new("nats://localhost:4222") } 在进程内模式下，这个地址只会被解析，不会真正连接。 测试按类型请求 Broker：tb.broker::<NatsBroker>()。 除此之外测试没有任何改动，包括第 8 章的延迟和 AsyncAPI 文档。

docker run --rm -p 4222:4222 nats:2-alpine cargo run -- run 在 Core NATS 上，主题名就是 subject。 Core NATS 不保存消息：在没有订阅者监听时发布的消息就此消失，投递也没有确认。 retry 或 retry_after 把一份副本发布回该 subject，尝试上限统计这些副本。 如果主题的消息必须在重启后保留，就改为读取 JetStream 流：在属性中使用 JetStreamSubject，并配一个持久消费者。 该 crate 的 nats_jetstream 示例展示了这样的用法，nats_retry 展示了每种订阅如何重试。

accept 用一个支付请求回复每个订单，并通过 Out 槽位通知顾客。路由器决定两者如何发出。 订阅者有两种发布方式。 回复是主体返回的值：主体成功之后，运行时对它编码并发布。 Out 槽位是一个发布者。主体把它作为参数接收，并自己调用，需要多少次就调用多少次。 消息发往哪里是消息类型的属性：#[outgoing(name = ..)] 固定主题，主体和挂载点都不必重复它。 槽位列出可以经由它发出的类型，发布其他任何类型都无法编译。 挂载点把每个发布位置绑定到一个发布策略，这里是 Broker 的普通 Publish。
documents.s: 回复与发布到其他主题

documents.t: 支付模块接收 PaymentRequest，Paid 是它在下一章给出的回复。 宏 手写 payments.rs /// What the orders side asks payments to charge. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "payments.requested")] pub(crate) struct PaymentRequest { pub(crate) order: u64, pub(crate) customer: String, pub(crate) lines: Vec<Line>, pub(crate) amount_cents: u64, pub(crate) request_id: String, } /// A charged order, on its way to shipping. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "payments.settled")] pub(crate) struct Paid { pub(crate) order: u64, pub(crate) customer: String, pub(crate) lines: Vec<Line>, } payments.rs /// What the orders side asks payments to charge. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema)] pub(crate) struct PaymentRequest { pub(crate) order: u64, pub(crate) customer: String, pub(crate) lines: Vec<Line>, pub(crate) amount_cents: u64, pub(crate) request_id: String, } // What `#[derive(Outgoing)]` with `#[outgoing(name = "payments.requested")]` writes. impl OutgoingDestination for PaymentRequest { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "payments.requested"; } impl MessageHeaders for PaymentRequest { type Contract = NoHeaders; } impl MessageInfo for PaymentRequest { const NAME: &'static str = "PaymentRequest"; const DESCRIPTION: Option<&'static str> = Some("What the orders side asks payments to charge."); } /// A charged order, on its way to shipping. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema)] pub(crate) struct Paid { pub(crate) order: u64, pub(crate) customer: String, pub(crate) lines: Vec<Line>, } impl OutgoingDestination for Paid { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "payments.settled"; } impl MessageHeaders for Paid { type Contract = NoHeaders; } impl MessageInfo for Paid { const NAME: &'static str = "Paid"; const DESCRIPTION: Option<&'static str> = Some("A charged order, on its way to shipping."); } Notice 是商店发给顾客的通知，OutSlot 标记 Notices 是它发出所经由的槽位。 手写形式写出 #[derive(OutSlot)] 生成的内容：槽位的名字、它发布的类型，以及这些类型在 AsyncAPI 文档中的条目。 宏 手写 notifications.rs /// What the shop tells a customer. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "notices")] pub(crate) struct Notice { pub(crate) customer: String, pub(crate) text: String, } /// The slot a subscriber tells customers through, and what may leave through it. #[derive(OutSlot)] #[publishes(Notice)] pub(crate) struct Notices; notifications.rs /// What the shop tells a customer. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema)] pub(crate) struct Notice { pub(crate) customer: String, pub(crate) text: String, } // What `#[derive(Outgoing)]` with `#[outgoing(name = "notices")]` writes. impl OutgoingDestination for Notice { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "notices"; } impl MessageHeaders for Notice { type Contract = NoHeaders; } impl MessageInfo for Notice { const NAME: &'static str = "Notice"; const DESCRIPTION: Option<&'static str> = Some("What the shop tells a customer."); } /// The slot a subscriber tells customers through, and what may leave through it. pub(crate) struct Notices; // What `#[derive(OutSlot)]` with `#[publishes(Notice)]` writes. impl OutSlot for Notices { const NAME: &'static str = "Notices"; // `Notice` fixes its destination, so no transform on this slot may name one. type Destination = Reads; fn outgoing() -> Vec<OutgoingMessageMetadata> { <Notice as OutMessages<Self>>::outgoing() } } impl PublishedThrough<Notices> for Notice {} impl<Slot: OutSlot> OutMessages<Slot> for Notice { fn outgoing() -> Vec<OutgoingMessageMetadata> { vec![OutgoingMessageMetadata::new( Self::DESTINATION, type_name::<Self>(), )] } }

没有订单行的订单，accept 直接丢弃，因为没有可收款的内容；超出商店上限的订单也会丢弃，因为它没有总额。 它通过槽位告诉顾客订单已收到，如果这次发布失败，就请求重试。 然后它返回支付请求，运行时把它作为回复发布。 Ok 发布回复并 ack，Err 不发布任何内容，按结果结算。 宏 手写 orders.rs /// Accepts an order: asks payments to charge it, and tells the customer it arrived. #[subscriber("orders.placed", reply)] async fn accept( order: &Order, Headers(meta): Headers<RequestMeta>, Out(notices): Out<impl Publisher, Notices>, ) -> Result<PaymentRequest, HandlerOutcome> { if order.lines.is_empty() { tracing::warn!(order = order.id, "an order with no lines, dropped"); return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); } let Some(amount_cents) = total_cents(&order.lines) else { tracing::warn!(order = order.id, "an order past the shop's bounds, dropped"); return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); }; let notice = Notice { customer: order.customer.clone(), text: format!("We have your order {}.", order.id), }; if notices.message(&notice).publish().await.is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } Ok(PaymentRequest { order: order.id, customer: order.customer.clone(), lines: order.lines.clone(), amount_cents, request_id: meta.request_id, }) } orders.rs /// Accepts an order: asks payments to charge it, and tells the customer it arrived. struct Accept; impl<Entry> Handle<Message<RequestMeta, Order>, PaymentRequest, Outs<(Entry,)>, (), Shop> for Accept where Entry: OutEntry<Notices, Wire: Publisher>, { async fn handle( &self, placed: &Message<RequestMeta, Order>, outs: &Outs<(Entry,)>, _ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Shop>, ) -> Result<PaymentRequest, HandlerOutcome> { let (meta, order) = (&placed.headers, &placed.body); if order.lines.is_empty() { tracing::warn!(order = order.id, "an order with no lines, dropped"); return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); } let Some(amount_cents) = total_cents(&order.lines) else { tracing::warn!(order = order.id, "an order past the shop's bounds, dropped"); return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); }; let notice = Notice { customer: order.customer.clone(), text: format!("We have your order {}.", order.id), }; if outs.get(Notices).message(&notice).publish().await.is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } Ok(PaymentRequest { order: order.id, customer: order.customer.clone(), lines: order.lines.clone(), amount_cents, request_id: meta.request_id.clone(), }) } } 在手写形式中，槽位是 Outs 中的一个条目，outs.get(Notices) 交出它的发布者。

Router 汇集一个模块的订阅者，以及它们各个发布位置的设置。 out_reply 把回复绑定到一个策略，.codec(INTERNAL) 用 CBOR 对它编码。 out 绑定槽位。槽位沿用路由器的编解码器，这里是 JSON。 路由器在 RouterDef<MemoryBroker, Shop> 中指明 Broker 和应用的状态类型，Shop 在第 7 章介绍。 宏 手写 orders.rs /// The orders side's subscribers, with where their messages go. pub(crate) fn routes() -> impl RouterDef<MemoryBroker, Shop> { Router::new() .include(audit) .include(accept) // The payment request travels as CBOR, the codec of the shop's own topics. .out_reply(Publish) .codec(INTERNAL) .out(Notices, Publish) .build() } orders.rs /// The orders side's subscribers, with where their messages go. pub(crate) fn routes() -> impl RouterDef<MemoryBroker, Shop> { Router::new() .include( subscriber(Order::DESTINATION, Audit) .describe( "Writes every placed order to the audit log, with the request that placed it.", ) .build(), ) .include( subscriber(Order::DESTINATION, Accept) .describe( "Accepts an order: asks payments to charge it, and tells the customer it \ arrived.", ) .reply() .build(), ) // The payment request travels as CBOR, the codec of the shop's own topics. .out_reply(Publish) .codec(INTERNAL) .out(Notices, Publish) .build() } 手写形式用 subscriber(..) 把每个订阅者绑定到它的主题，.describe(..) 给它描述，相当于宏从文档注释得到的描述。 include_router 把路由器挂载到 Broker 上，第 5 章展示完成这一步的应用。

商店从一个订阅者起步。它接收每一个已下的订单，由一个小应用挂载在内存 Broker 上。 RustStream 服务是一个应用：一个构建器，它列出自己的 Broker，并在上面挂载订阅者。 订阅者是一个 async fn，第一个参数是消息，#[subscriber] 指明它读取的主题。 运行时在主体运行之前解码载荷，默认使用 JSON。 主体的返回值决定如何结算这次投递：HandlerOutcome::ack 告诉 Broker 这条消息已处理完毕。 内存 Broker 在进程内部传递消息，所以商店不需要安装任何东西。 第 11 章把它换成联网的 Broker，订阅者保持不变。
documents.s: 服务和它的第一个订阅者

documents.t: 订单是一个 serde 类型。 Outgoing derive 声明订单发布到哪里：orders.placed。 商店自己还不发布订单。现在由测试发布，第 10 章起由 HTTP 店面发布。 宏 手写 examples/guide/first.rs /// An order placed in the storefront. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, Serialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "orders.placed")] struct Order { id: u64, customer: String, } examples/manual/guide/first.rs /// An order placed in the storefront. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, Serialize, schemars::JsonSchema)] struct Order { id: u64, customer: String, } // What `#[derive(Outgoing)]` with `#[outgoing(name = "orders.placed")]` writes. impl OutgoingDestination for Order { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "orders.placed"; } impl MessageHeaders for Order { type Contract = NoHeaders; } 手写形式写出 derive 生成的两个 impl：目的地，以及订单携带的消息头（目前没有）。

accept 读取 orders.placed，并通过 tracing 记录每个订单。 手写形式是一个具名类型，带有 impl Handle<Order>：Ok(()) 表示 ack，Err(outcome) 按该结果结算。 宏 手写 examples/guide/first.rs /// Takes every placed order; for now it only logs it. #[subscriber("orders.placed")] async fn accept(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order = order.id, customer = %order.customer, "order accepted"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } examples/manual/guide/first.rs /// Takes every placed order; for now it only logs it. struct Accept; impl Handle<Order> for Accept { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order = order.id, customer = %order.customer, "order accepted"); ready(Ok(())) } }

RustStream 就是应用。with_broker 注册一个 Broker，并用 include 在上面挂载订阅者。 闭包返回 include 开启的链，每多一个订阅者，就在链上再写一次 .include(..)。 构建器只记录交给它的内容：Broker 在服务启动时才连接。 #[ruststream::app] 属性把构建器变成 main，并带有 run 和 asyncapi gen 命令。 手写形式亲手写出这个 main：在构建器之上调用 run_main。 宏 手写 examples/guide/first.rs #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("shop", "0.1.0")) .with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| b.include(accept)) } examples/manual/guide/first.rs fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("shop", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { b.include(subscriber("orders.placed", Accept).build()) }) } /// What `#[ruststream::app]` writes: the `run` and `asyncapi gen` commands over `app`. fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) }

cargo run --example guide_first --features testing,macros,memory,json,logging -- run logging feature 把服务的日志打印到终端。 服务连接 Broker，打开订阅，然后一直运行到 Ctrl+C： INFO ruststream::lifecycle starting service service=shop version=0.1.0 brokers=1 subscribers=1 INFO ruststream::lifecycle broker connected broker="ruststream::memory::MemoryBroker" INFO ruststream::dispatch subscriber started subscriber=orders.placed input="guide_first::Order" INFO ruststream::lifecycle service running subscribers=1 本指南的其余部分把这个文件逐步扩展成 examples/guide 中的商店。

支付服务商每次拒绝，charge 都给出所需的结果：立即重试、稍后重试、丢弃，或者转入死信主题。 每次投递都以一个结果结束。 ack 完成它，drop 丢弃它，retry 请求 Broker 再投递一次。 retry_after 在一段延迟之后再投递一次，不会阻塞排在它后面的投递。 一直不成功的重试会无休止地回来，因此挂载点限定尝试次数。 超过上限后，投递进入死信主题，运维人员或其他服务可以在那里查看它。

支付服务商有三种拒绝方式，每种需要不同的结果。 Busy 表示它的速率限额暂时用完：立即重试仍会被拒绝，所以 retry_after 等待一秒。 Unavailable 表示它没有应答：retry 立即再试一次。 Declined 表示卡上余额不足，再试一次也是同样的答复，所以这笔支付被丢弃。 服务商的客户端来自应用的状态，状态在第 7 章打开。 宏 手写 payments.rs /// How long a busy provider asks its callers to wait. pub(crate) const BACKOFF: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1); /// Charges an order through the payment provider. #[subscriber("payments.requested", reply)] async fn charge( request: &PaymentRequest, State(gateway): State<Arc<Gateway>>, ) -> Result<Paid, HandlerOutcome> { match gateway.charge(request).await { Ok(()) => Ok(Paid { order: request.order, customer: request.customer.clone(), lines: request.lines.clone(), }), // Past the rate limit: a redelivery right now would be refused again. Err(Refusal::Busy) => Err(HandlerOutcome::retry_after(BACKOFF)), // No answer: try again at once, up to the attempt cap. Err(Refusal::Unavailable) => Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()), // A refused card stays refused. Err(Refusal::Declined) => { tracing::warn!(order = request.order, "card declined, payment dropped"); Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()) } } } payments.rs /// How long a busy provider asks its callers to wait. pub(crate) const BACKOFF: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1); /// Charges an order through the payment provider. struct Charge; // The state type is the last parameter of `Handle`; the mount checks it against the app's. impl Handle<PaymentRequest, Paid, (), (), Shop> for Charge { async fn handle( &self, request: &PaymentRequest, _outs: &(), ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Shop>, ) -> Result<Paid, HandlerOutcome> { let State(gateway) = State::<Arc<Gateway>>::from_context(ctx).await?; match gateway.charge(request).await { Ok(()) => Ok(Paid { order: request.order, customer: request.customer.clone(), lines: request.lines.clone(), }), // Past the rate limit: a redelivery right now would be refused again. Err(Refusal::Busy) => Err(HandlerOutcome::retry_after(BACKOFF)), // No answer: try again at once, up to the attempt cap. Err(Refusal::Unavailable) => Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()), // A refused card stays refused. Err(Refusal::Declined) => { tracing::warn!(order = request.order, "card declined, payment dropped"); Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()) } } } }

max_attempts 统计一条消息的每次投递，第一次也算在内。 第五次投递不再重试：dead_letter 把它发布到 payments.dead，载荷和消息头保持到达时的样子。 路由器以 CBOR 解码请求，并以同样的方式编码回复。 宏 手写 payments.rs /// The payments side's subscriber: five deliveries at most, then the dead-letter topic. pub(crate) fn routes() -> impl RouterDef<MemoryBroker, Shop> { Router::new() .with_codec(INTERNAL) .include(charge) .max_attempts(nonzero!(5u32)) .dead_letter("payments.dead") .out_reply(Publish) .codec(INTERNAL) .build() } payments.rs /// The payments side's subscriber: five deliveries at most, then the dead-letter topic. pub(crate) fn routes() -> impl RouterDef<MemoryBroker, Shop> { Router::new() .with_codec(INTERNAL) .include( subscriber(PaymentRequest::DESTINATION, Charge) .describe("Charges an order through the payment provider.") .reply() .build(), ) .max_attempts(nonzero!(5u32)) .dead_letter("payments.dead") .out_reply(Publish) .codec(INTERNAL) .build() } 内存 Broker 自己完成重新投递，延迟正是 retry_after 要求的时长。 如果 Broker 无法延迟一次投递，就把一份副本发布回该订阅。重试副本的去向讲解了这一点。 第 8 章测试全部三条路径，包括延迟，而且不必真的等待。

支付客户端和邮件发送器在启动时打开一次，以 State 的形式到达每个订阅者；上下文告诉订阅者它拿到的是哪次投递。 服务在订阅者之间共享客户端、连接池和缓存。 应用在 on_startup 中打开它们，时机在第一个订阅打开之前。这里出现错误会中止启动。 钩子的返回值是应用的状态，整个服务只有这一个值。 订阅者以 State<T> 参数的形式取用其中的一个字段。 上下文是按投递划分的那一半：订阅的名字、消息头、Broker 为这次投递提供的字段。 订阅者以 &mut Context 参数的形式取用它，紧跟在消息之后。

Shop 持有支付客户端和邮件发送器，两者各自放在 Arc 后面，所以克隆的开销很小。 FromRef 从状态中投影出每个字段：State<Arc<Gateway>> 就是通过它解析的。 open 是第 5 章中应用传给 on_startup 的钩子。 宏 手写 state.rs /// The app's state: each field reaches a subscriber as `State<FieldType>`. #[derive(Clone, FromRef)] pub(crate) struct Shop { pub(crate) gateway: Arc<Gateway>, pub(crate) mailer: Arc<Mailer>, } impl Shop { /// Opens the clients. The app runs it once, before the first subscription opens; an error /// stops the startup. pub(crate) async fn open() -> Result<Self, MailError> { Ok(Self { gateway: Arc::new(Gateway::new(CARD_LIMIT_CENTS, CHARGES_PER_SECOND)), mailer: Arc::new(Mailer::connect("smtp://mail.internal:25").await?), }) } } state.rs /// The app's state: each field reaches a subscriber as `State<FieldType>`. #[derive(Clone)] pub(crate) struct Shop { pub(crate) gateway: Arc<Gateway>, pub(crate) mailer: Arc<Mailer>, } // What `#[derive(FromRef)]` writes for each field: `State<Arc<Gateway>>` resolves through it. impl FromRef<Shop> for Arc<Gateway> { fn from_ref(shop: &Shop) -> Self { shop.gateway.clone() } } impl FromRef<Shop> for Arc<Mailer> { fn from_ref(shop: &Shop) -> Self { shop.mailer.clone() } } impl Shop { /// Opens the clients. The app runs it once, before the first subscription opens; an error /// stops the startup. pub(crate) async fn open() -> Result<Self, MailError> { Ok(Self { gateway: Arc::new(Gateway::new(CARD_LIMIT_CENTS, CHARGES_PER_SECOND)), mailer: Arc::new(Mailer::connect("smtp://mail.internal:25").await?), }) } } 手写形式写出 derive 生成的两个 impl，每个字段一个。

send 通过状态中的邮件发送器用电子邮件发出通知。 不存在的邮箱再试也还是不存在，所以被拒绝的通知直接丢弃，警告中指明取自上下文的订阅。 宏 手写 notifications.rs /// E-mails a notice to the customer. // The mailer comes from the app's state; the context names the subscription in the warning. #[subscriber("notices")] async fn send( notice: &Notice, ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Shop>, State(mailer): State<Arc<Mailer>>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { match mailer.send(&notice.customer, &notice.text).await { Ok(()) => HandlerOutcome::ack(), Err(error) => { // A refused mailbox stays refused; another try would only repeat the warning. tracing::warn!(subscription = ctx.name(), %error, "notice not sent"); HandlerOutcome::drop() } } } notifications.rs /// E-mails a notice to the customer. struct Mail; // The mailer comes from the app's state; the context names the subscription in the warning. impl Handle<Notice, (), (), (), Shop> for Mail { async fn handle( &self, notice: &Notice, _outs: &(), ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Shop>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let State(mailer) = State::<Arc<Mailer>>::from_context(ctx).await?; if let Err(error) = mailer.send(&notice.customer, &notice.text).await { // A refused mailbox stays refused; another try would only repeat the warning. tracing::warn!(subscription = ctx.name(), %error, "notice not sent"); return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); } Ok(()) } } 在手写形式中，状态类型是 Handle 的最后一个参数，挂载时会把它与应用的状态类型核对。 主体用 from_context 读取字段，这正是宏对 State 参数所做的事。 自定义提取器是你自己的类型，以同样的方式读取。

documents.h: #同一个订阅者中的状态与上下文

documents.t: TestApp 在进程内运行商店自己的应用：测试发布一个订单，然后检查每个订阅者做了什么、每个主题收到了什么。 测试用 TestApp::start 启动 main 运行的那个应用，不做任何改动。 Broker 在进程内连接，每个订阅都运行在测试的运行时上。 测试中的一次发布会等到它引发的一切都结算之后才返回，所以下一行就能检查结果。 断言读取两份记录：每个订阅者收到了什么、如何结算，以及每个主题上发布了什么。 在暂停的时钟上，advance 让时间前进，所以一秒或一小时的延迟都不花费任何时间。 测试需要 crate 的 testing feature，通常作为开发依赖。

测试带着请求消息头下一个订单，并一路跟踪到顾客。 支付请求以 CBOR 传递，所以断言用 with_codec 解码它。 accept 和 dispatch 各发送一条通知，send 对两条都 ack。 宏 手写 main.rs #[tokio::test] async fn a_placed_order_is_charged_shipped_and_announced() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; tb.message(&order(7, mugs(12))) .with_headers(&meta("req-7")) .publish() .await?; let broker = tb.broker::<MemoryBroker>(); broker .published::<PaymentRequest>("payments.requested") .assert_called_once() .with_codec( &CborCodec, &PaymentRequest { order: 7, customer: "ada@example.com".to_owned(), lines: mugs(12), amount_cents: 14_400, request_id: "req-7".to_owned(), }, ); broker .published::<Notice>("notices") .assert_called(2) .with(&Notice { customer: "ada@example.com".to_owned(), text: "Order 7 is on its way: TRK-7-2.".to_owned(), }); broker .subscriber("notices") .assert_called(2) .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); Ok(()) } main.rs #[tokio::test] async fn a_placed_order_is_charged_shipped_and_announced() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; tb.message(&order(7, mugs(12))) .with_headers(&meta("req-7")) .publish() .await?; let broker = tb.broker::<MemoryBroker>(); broker .published::<PaymentRequest>("payments.requested") .assert_called_once() .with_codec( &CborCodec, &PaymentRequest { order: 7, customer: "ada@example.com".to_owned(), lines: mugs(12), amount_cents: 14_400, request_id: "req-7".to_owned(), }, ); broker .published::<Notice>("notices") .assert_called(2) .with(&Notice { customer: "ada@example.com".to_owned(), text: "Order 7 is on its way: TRK-7-2.".to_owned(), }); broker .subscriber("notices") .assert_called(2) .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); Ok(()) }

没有订单行的订单停在 accept：不收款，也不通知顾客。 宏 手写 main.rs #[tokio::test] async fn an_order_with_no_lines_goes_no_further() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; tb.message(&order(8, Vec::new())) .with_headers(&meta("req-8")) .publish() .await?; let broker = tb.broker::<MemoryBroker>(); broker .published::<PaymentRequest>("payments.requested") .assert_not_called(); broker.published::<Notice>("notices").assert_not_called(); Ok(()) } main.rs #[tokio::test] async fn an_order_with_no_lines_goes_no_further() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; tb.message(&order(8, Vec::new())) .with_headers(&meta("req-8")) .publish() .await?; let broker = tb.broker::<MemoryBroker>(); broker .published::<PaymentRequest>("payments.requested") .assert_not_called(); broker.published::<Notice>("notices").assert_not_called(); Ok(()) }

每秒只接受一笔收款的服务商会以 Busy 拒绝第二个请求。 with_state 用这个服务商启动应用，代替 on_startup 打开的那个。 service.rs 中的 test_broker 返回测试构建商店所用的 Broker，所以测试只在一处写明 Broker。 时钟从暂停状态开始，advance(BACKOFF) 让被拒绝的请求回来。 宏 手写 payments.rs #[tokio::test(start_paused = true)] async fn a_busy_provider_is_asked_again_after_the_backoff() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { // A provider that takes one charge a second. let state = Shop { gateway: Arc::new(Gateway::new(100_000, 1)), ..Shop::open().await? }; let tb = TestApp::with_state(shop(test_broker()), |_| state).await?; let broker = tb.broker::<MemoryBroker>(); for order in [1, 2] { broker .message(&request(order, 500)) .with_codec(CborCodec) .publish() .await?; } broker .subscriber("payments.requested") .assert_called(2) .settled(HandlerOutcome::retry_after(BACKOFF)); tb.advance(BACKOFF).await?; broker .subscriber("payments.requested") .assert_called(3) .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); broker .published::<Paid>("payments.settled") .assert_called(2); Ok(()) } payments.rs #[tokio::test(start_paused = true)] async fn a_busy_provider_is_asked_again_after_the_backoff() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { // A provider that takes one charge a second. let state = Shop { gateway: Arc::new(Gateway::new(100_000, 1)), ..Shop::open().await? }; let tb = TestApp::with_state(shop(test_broker()), |_| state).await?; let broker = tb.broker::<MemoryBroker>(); for order in [1, 2] { broker .message(&request(order, 500)) .with_codec(CborCodec) .publish() .await?; } broker .subscriber("payments.requested") .assert_called(2) .settled(HandlerOutcome::retry_after(BACKOFF)); tb.advance(BACKOFF).await?; broker .subscriber("payments.requested") .assert_called(3) .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); broker .published::<Paid>("payments.settled") .assert_called(2); Ok(()) }

从不应答的服务商让每次投递都失败。 第五次投递按到达时的原样进入 payments.dead。 宏 手写 payments.rs #[tokio::test] async fn a_silent_provider_sends_the_request_to_the_dead_letter_topic() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let state = Shop::open().await?; state.gateway.go_offline(); let tb = TestApp::with_state(shop(test_broker()), |_| state).await?; let broker = tb.broker::<MemoryBroker>(); broker .message(&request(3, 500)) .with_codec(CborCodec) .publish() .await?; broker.subscriber("payments.requested").assert_called(5); broker .published::<PaymentRequest>("payments.dead") .assert_called_once() .with_codec(&CborCodec, &request(3, 500)); Ok(()) } payments.rs #[tokio::test] async fn a_silent_provider_sends_the_request_to_the_dead_letter_topic() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let state = Shop::open().await?; state.gateway.go_offline(); let tb = TestApp::with_state(shop(test_broker()), |_| state).await?; let broker = tb.broker::<MemoryBroker>(); broker .message(&request(3, 500)) .with_codec(CborCodec) .publish() .await?; broker.subscriber("payments.requested").assert_called(5); broker .published::<PaymentRequest>("payments.dead") .assert_called_once() .with_codec(&CborCodec, &request(3, 500)); Ok(()) } 运行两种形式的测试： cargo test --example guide --features testing,macros,memory,json,cbor,asyncapi cargo test --example manual_guide --no-default-features --features testing,memory,json,cbor,asyncapi 两个目录中的测试相同，它们在商店的两种形式上都能通过。

仓库附带了智能体技能：编码智能体在任务需要时加载的指南，让它写出的代码遵循框架推荐的路径。 在 Claude Code 中用两条命令安装： /plugin marketplace add powersemmi/ruststream /plugin install ruststream@ruststream 插件提供五个技能。 智能体根据描述选择技能，所以关于 RustStream 服务的请求即使不点名，也会加载对应的技能。 技能 智能体何时使用 ruststream 编写服务：处理器、应用、回复、发布、重试、状态、编解码器 ruststream-testing 用 TestApp 测试服务 ruststream-without-macros 不启用 macros feature 构建服务 ruststream-broker 编写 Broker crate ruststream-core 为核心仓库贡献代码
每个技能是一个目录，包含 SKILL.md 和它的参考页面，位于仓库的 .agents/skills/。 Cursor 和 Codex 从所在项目的 .agents/skills/ 读取技能。 要让智能体在你的服务中使用这些技能，把需要的目录复制到你项目的这个目录，或复制到你的智能体读取的技能目录。
技能描述的是它所在修订版本的框架。 请从与服务所依赖的 ruststream 相同的发布线安装技能。 技能是指南而不是检查：结果仍由编译器和测试来判定。

服务只依赖一个 crate：ruststream，它的接口全部由可加的 cargo feature 控制。它重新导出构成 RustStream 的各个 crate，所以服务从不直接引用它们。把它加进你的 Cargo.toml： [dependencies] ruststream = { version = "0.8", features = ["macros", "memory", "json"] } serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] } serde 是你服务的直接依赖，因为消息类型要 derive Deserialize / Serialize。 Edition 与 MSRV RustStream 面向 edition 2024，最低支持的 Rust 版本是 1.95。在你的 Cargo.toml 里写上 edition = "2024"。 如果 Broker crate 的客户端库需要更新的工具链，它的下限就会高于核心。确切的下限见该 Broker crate 自己的 rust-version 字段。

核心的各个 trait、RustStream 应用对象、Router、中间件和面向订阅者的消息分发始终参与编译。 其余的一切都是可加的 feature，你按需启用。 feature 引入依赖 提供什么 json （默认） serde_json JsonCodec msgpack rmp-serde MsgpackCodec cbor ciborium CborCodec memory - MemoryBroker，作为参考实现的内存 Broker macros ruststream-macros #[subscriber]、#[ruststream::app]，以及各个 derive（Outgoing、OutSlot、OutMessages、Deserialized、Serialized、FromRef、MessageInfo） asyncapi schemars, serde_norway AsyncAPI 生成与 HTML 查看器 metrics prometheus Prometheus 中间件与导出器 logging tracing-subscriber ruststream::logging，彩色的控制台日志记录器（日志） otel opentelemetry, opentelemetry-otlp 通过 OTLP 导出链路与指标，并按 W3C 规范传递 trace-context（OpenTelemetry） testing inventory TestApp 与断言构建器（测试） conformance inventory 面向 Broker 作者的 conformance 校验套件 cli clap, anyhow ruststream 二进制程序 一个服务里可以同时启用多个编解码器（参见编解码器）。要去掉内置的 JSON 编解码器（例如在只需要 trait 和运行时的 Broker crate 里），关掉默认 feature，并指明运行时： [dependencies] ruststream = { version = "0.8", default-features = false, features = ["tokio"] }

面向设备的 Broker crate 可以只依赖契约。ruststream-core 包含 trait 和消息类型，它以 #![no_std] 构建，只需要一个内存分配器： [dependencies] ruststream-core = { version = "0.8", default-features = false, features = ["alloc"] } 它的 std feature 默认开启，ruststream 也会打开它。运行时、编解码器和测试工具需要标准库。
ruststream 二进制程序随 crate 一起发布，由 cargo feature cli 控制。它用框架的子命令（run、 asyncapi gen）驱动 cargo；安装方式和各个命令见 runtime::cli 模块。新项目的骨架由 cargo generate 按模板生成，参见快速上手。

memory Broker 内置在 crate 里，不需要外部服务。要连接进程之外的 Broker，就依赖它的 crate： 该 crate 会从 ruststream 重新导出自己需要的东西。 每个 Broker 独立管理版本和发布，因此确切的依赖写法要看它自己的文档。那里给出当前版本，以及用于 处理器测试的 testing feature。同一份文档还描述了它的连接选项和各项能力。 可用的 Broker 列在 Broker 一节，从那里可以进到每个 Broker 的文档。 想自己写一个 Broker，参见 Broker trait 的文档。
要让服务跑起来，最快的方式是用 cargo generate 生成项目骨架。

cargo install cargo-generate cargo generate --git https://github.com/powersemmi/ruststream templates/memory --name my-service cd my-service 生成骨架只需要 cargo generate。templates/memory 是基于内存 Broker 的起步模板。自带模板的 Broker crate 用同样的方式生成，指明该 crate 的仓库和模板路径（例如 --git https://github.com/powersemmi/ruststream-nats templates/nats）；某个 Broker 有哪些模板， 以它自己的文档为准。cargo generate 会生成一个符合 Rust 习惯的多文件项目： my-service/ ├── Cargo.toml └── src/ ├── main.rs # #[ruststream::app] 构建服务并挂载路由器 ├── orders.rs # 以 #[subscriber] 函数编写的处理器（其中一个会发布回复） └── routes.rs # 把这些处理器汇总进一个 Router

#[ruststream::app] 会生成 main，因此二进制程序已经支持框架的命令： cargo run -- run # 或者：装了 CLI 之后用 ruststream run cargo run -- run 会启动 tokio 运行时。服务会一直运行，直到你按下 Ctrl+C。运行服务不需要外部 Broker。模板打开了 logging feature， 所以服务会把日志打印到终端，处理器则通过 tracing 写日志。
cargo run -- asyncapi gen 该命令以 JSON 格式打印 AsyncAPI 文档。输出选项（-o、--yaml）和文档本身，参见 asyncapi 模块。

宏 手写 src/main.rs mod orders; mod routes; use ruststream::memory::MemoryBroker; use ruststream::runtime::{AppInfo, RustStream}; #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders-service", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { let router = routes::orders(); b.include_router(router) }) } src/main.rs mod orders; mod routes; use std::process::ExitCode; use ruststream::memory::prelude::*; use ruststream::runtime::cli::run_main; fn app() -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders-service", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { let router = routes::orders(); b.include_router(router) }) } // What `#[ruststream::app]` writes around the builder: the `run` and `asyncapi gen` commands. fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } 你写的是一个构建服务的函数，#[ruststream::app] 把它变成 main。
在教程中理解每个部分。 在订阅者中了解处理器的各种写法。 用 CLI 管理服务。
本教程从零开始构建一个订单服务，并逐块讲解。服务运行在内存 Broker 上，不需要额外启动任何外部 服务。换成真正的 Broker 只是一行改动，第 7 步会讲到。
documents.s: 教程：构建你的第一个服务

documents.t: cargo new orders-service cd orders-service Cargo.toml [package] name = "orders-service" version = "0.1.0" edition = "2024" [dependencies] ruststream = { version = "0.8", features = ["macros", "memory", "json", "asyncapi", "logging"] } serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] } tracing = "0.1"

处理器是一个 async fn，第一个参数是解码后的载荷。#[subscriber] 宏把它变成可挂载的定义，名字 取自函数名。 宏 手写 src/orders.rs use ruststream::runtime::HandlerOutcome; use ruststream::schemars::JsonSchema; use ruststream::{Outgoing, subscriber}; use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize}; /// An order placed by a customer. #[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] pub(crate) struct Order { pub(crate) id: u64, pub(crate) quantity: u32, } #[subscriber("orders")] pub(crate) async fn handle(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order.id, order.quantity, "order received"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/orders.rs use std::future::ready; use ruststream::prelude::*; use ruststream::schemars::JsonSchema; use serde::Deserialize; /// An order placed by a customer. #[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] pub(crate) struct Order { pub(crate) id: u64, pub(crate) quantity: u32, } /// The handler: `#[subscriber("orders")]` generates this struct and this impl. The subject it /// carried is named where the handler is mounted instead. pub(crate) struct Receive; impl Handle<Order> for Receive { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, order.quantity, "order received"); ready(Ok(())) } } 处理器返回 HandlerOutcome：要么是 ack，要么是 nack。 nack 丢弃消息，或者把它重新入队。处理器也可以返回 () 或 Result<(), E>，其中 Ok 表示 ack，Err 表示丢弃。 JsonSchema derive 把载荷的 schema 写进第 6 步的 AsyncAPI 文档。文档里这条消息的描述取自类型的 文档注释。这不需要额外的依赖：asyncapi feature 已经重导出了 schemars。

宏 手写 src/main.rs mod orders; use ruststream::memory::MemoryBroker; use ruststream::runtime::{AppInfo, RustStream}; use crate::orders::handle; #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders-service", "0.1.0")) .with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| b.include(handle)) } src/main.rs mod orders; use std::process::ExitCode; use ruststream::memory::prelude::*; use ruststream::runtime::cli::run_main; use crate::orders::Receive; fn app() -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders-service", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { b.include(subscriber("orders", Receive).build()) }) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } 编解码器的默认值 include 用默认编解码器解码，因此不需要编解码器参数。默认编解码器由 json、cbor、 msgpack 中第一个启用的 feature 选出。要让该 Broker 下的所有处理器换用另一个编解码器， 可以用 with_broker_codec(broker, codec, |b| ...) 设定一次。 完整的选取规则参见编解码器。 运行它： cargo run -- run logging feature 会把服务的日志打印到终端：先是启动时的几行，然后处理器每用 tracing::info! 记录一个订单，就多一行。

要发布一条回复，就返回回复值，并在订阅者上写 reply。目的地由回复类型上的 Outgoing derive 声明： 宏 手写 src/orders.rs /// The service's answer to an order. #[derive(Debug, Serialize, JsonSchema, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "confirmations")] pub(crate) struct Confirmation { pub(crate) id: u64, pub(crate) accepted: bool, } #[subscriber("orders", reply)] pub(crate) async fn confirm(order: &Order) -> Confirmation { Confirmation { id: order.id, accepted: order.quantity > 0, } } src/orders.rs use serde::Serialize; /// The service's answer to an order, published on `confirmations`. #[derive(Debug, Serialize, JsonSchema)] pub(crate) struct Confirmation { pub(crate) id: u64, pub(crate) accepted: bool, } /// What `#[derive(Outgoing)]` with `#[outgoing(name = "confirmations")]` writes: the destination /// is fixed on the type, so nothing else names it. impl OutgoingDestination for Confirmation { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "confirmations"; } impl MessageHeaders for Confirmation { type Contract = NoHeaders; } /// The reply form of the same trait: the second parameter of `Handle` is the reply type, so the /// body returns a `Confirmation`, and the mount site supplies the publisher it leaves through. pub(crate) struct Confirm; impl Handle<Order, Confirmation> for Confirm { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Confirmation, HandlerOutcome>> { ready(Ok(Confirmation { id: order.id, accepted: order.quantity > 0, })) } } 用同一个 include 把 confirm 挂在 handle 旁边。回复由 Broker 的默认发布策略发出，并用默认 编解码器编码。 宏 手写 src/main.rs use crate::orders::{confirm, handle}; #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders-service", "0.1.0")) .with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| b.include(handle).include(confirm)) } src/main.rs use crate::orders::{Confirm, Receive}; fn app() -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders-service", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { b.include(subscriber("orders", Receive).build()) // The definition names the reply's destination; with no `.out_reply(..)` at the // mount site the reply leaves through the broker's default publisher. .include( subscriber("orders", Confirm) .reply() .to("confirmations") .build(), ) }) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } 在处理器内部发布以及其余的发布方式，参见发布与回复。

处理器多起来以后，把它们放进各自的模块，再汇总到 Router 里： 宏 手写 src/routes.rs use ruststream::memory::prelude::*; use crate::orders; // The reply wiring is a publish policy: pure declaration, so the router needs no broker at all. pub(crate) fn orders() -> impl RouterDef<MemoryBroker> { Router::new() .include(orders::handle) .include(orders::confirm) .out_reply(Publish) .build() } src/routes.rs use ruststream::memory::prelude::*; use crate::orders::{Confirm, Receive}; // Each handler is bound to its subject where it is mounted; the definition says what it replies // with, the reply type says where it goes, and the mount chain names who publishes it. The // publisher wiring is still a publish policy - pure declaration, so the router needs no broker // at all. pub(crate) fn orders() -> impl RouterDef<MemoryBroker> { Router::new() .include(subscriber("orders", Receive).build()) .include(subscriber("orders", Confirm).reply().build()) .out_reply(Publish) .build() } 带回复的处理器用链式调用挂到路由器上：.out_reply(..) 指定回复的发布策略，.build() 提交这次 注册。不写 .out_reply(..) 时，.build() 采用 Broker 的默认发布策略，也就是第 4 步里 include 用的那一个。路由器的其余用法参见路由。 宏 手写 src/main.rs mod orders; mod routes; use ruststream::memory::MemoryBroker; use ruststream::runtime::{AppInfo, RustStream}; #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders-service", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { let router = routes::orders(); b.include_router(router) }) } src/main.rs mod orders; mod routes; use std::process::ExitCode; use ruststream::memory::prelude::*; use ruststream::runtime::cli::run_main; fn app() -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders-service", "0.1.0")).with_broker(MemoryBroker::new(), |b| { let router = routes::orders(); b.include_router(router) }) } // What `#[ruststream::app]` writes around the builder: the `run` and `asyncapi gen` commands. fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) }

cargo run -- asyncapi gen 每个订阅者都会给文档添加一个通道和一个 receive 操作。handle 和 confirm 共用 orders 这个 通道，但各自有一个操作：两者的订阅是分开的。回复在 confirmations 上添加一个 send 操作。 载荷的 schema 放在文档的 components.messages 下。输出参数（-o、--yaml）和文档本身参见 AsyncAPI。

上面写的一切都不绑定在内存 Broker 上。Broker 在 with_broker 处选定，更换只是一行改动。把对应的 Broker crate 加进依赖，在那里构造它，例如用 NatsBroker::new("nats://localhost:4222") 代替 MemoryBroker::new()。处理器、路由器和编解码器保持不变。可用的 Broker 和每一种的替换写法，参见 Broker。 完整的服务是一个可编译的示例 本页的每一段代码都来自仓库里的 examples/tutorial， CI 每次改动都会构建它。first_app.rs 和 reply_app.rs 是第 3 步和第 4 步结束时的服务， main.rs 是最终版本。你也可以用 cargo run --example tutorial --features macros,memory,json,asyncapi,logging -- run 自己运行一遍。
中间件：围绕处理器的横切逻辑。 生命周期：共享状态与启动/关闭钩子。 测试：在进程内测试你刚写好的处理器。 指标：Prometheus 计数器与直方图。
